fee_notes: Royalty is 7% of Gross Sales, payable weekly via EFT; may be collected on a different interval (e.g., monthly). Brand Development Fund contribution is currently 2% of Gross Sales, payable weekly. Local Advertising Requirement is the greater of (a) $1,500 or (b) 2% of prior month's Gross Sales, payable monthly. A Marketing Expenditure Cap of 7% of Gross Sales per month applies in aggregate to Fund Contributions, Co-Op contributions, and Local Advertising Requirement combined. Technology Fee is currently $304/month and may be increased by 50% annually. Music Licensing Fee is currently included in the Technology Fee but may be separately charged. Regional/Local Advertising Co-Op contributions are as determined by the Co-Op (not currently charged).
raw_excerpt:
Royalty | 7% of Gross Sales generated by your Studio over the relevant reporting period | Payable weekly via electronic funds transfer ("EFT") based on the Gross Sales of your Studio during the preceding business week | You will be required to start paying your Royalty once your Studio begins collecting revenue from operations. We may collect your Royalty on a different interval (for example, monthly).
Contributions to Brand Development Fund | Currently, 2% of Gross Sales | Payable weekly at the same time and in the same manner as the Royalty | Your contributions (the "Fund Contributions") to the Brand Development Fund (the "Fund") will begin when your Studio begins generating revenue from operations. We may, on notice to you, adjust the amount of your required Fund Contributions, subject to the Marketing Expenditure Cap.
Regional or Local Advertising Co-Op | As the Co-Op determines (not currently charged) | As the Co-Op determines | We may establish regional cooperatives comprised of Studios that are within a given geographical area (each, a "Co-Op").
Local Advertising Requirement | The greater of (a) $1,500 or (b) 2% of the prior month's Gross Sales | Payable monthly with your 1st Royalty payment each month | This is a spending requirement, but we reserve the right to have you pay this amount to us rather than spending it yourself. We may, on notice to you, adjust the amount of your required spending, subject to the Marketing Expenditure Cap.
Technology Fee | Currently, $304/month | Payable monthly | We charge you a recurring Technology Fee to help cover the costs and expenses associated with developing, implementing, licensing or otherwise using and integrating the technology we determine appropriate to provide as part of the System or otherwise in connection with your Studio and/or Studio network. We may increase the Technology Fee by 50% annually.
